⭐️ Time to run it back!!! So excited to collaborate with MOC again for another Natural Dye Workshop :) happening in SSMU 201-B at 7:30pm on Wednesday the 28th. All are welcome, so you know the drill: bring your friends, fabric (light coloured shirts, bandanas, etc.), and a container to bring your dyed items home in - get excited 😌

Can’t wait to see you guys! ❤️

Want to bling up your accessories? Circle of Fashion is hosting a Bedazzling Workshop with @dsignlabmcgill! 🪩✨

Join us on the 2nd floor in Lev Bukhman 203 on November 5th from 12 PM– 3:00 PM!

We’ll be providing all creative materials, bedazzling supplies, and drinks & snacks!

No sign-up needed, everyone is welcome ✨

Feel free to bring your own items to customize (denim, phone cases, totes, you name it)

Come hang out, sip something sweet, and get creative with us 💫

With auditions coming up, we can imagine you have many questions on your mind. As such, here are a few frequently asked questions about Savoy and auditions answered. We hope these will clarify some of your concerns, but if any still persist, don’t hesitate to reach out via our Instagram DMs or email secretary.savoy@gmail.com

Auditions are on from September 22nd to 24th! Sign up today via our website mcgillsavoy.ca/gondoliers or by the link in bio.
Illustration credit: @faerie.allie

⭐️ Lastly we have our amazing VP Finance Opal, welcome new and awesome VP Internal Vanesa, and our VP Comms Bea!!! Opal is a U2 Accounting student, Vanesa is a U2 International Development Studies student, and Bea is a U2 English Cultural Studies student!

Thank you Opal for handling every one of our club’s financial needs and Vanesa for making amazing and packed monthly newsletters <3! Gonna be the best year!!

⭐️ STAY IN THE LOOP WITH DSIGN LAB ⭐️ 

Check out the form in our bio to become a Dsign Lab member by signing up for our NEWSLETTER

Our first newsletter is coming out next week - filled with Dsign Lab updates about our events, creative events hosted by McGill clubs, and other Montreal design and art happenings

If you’re in a McGill club and you have an event coming up that you’d like us to share in our newsletter, send us a message and let us know! We’ll try our best to add it into our next newsletter 💜

Self Tape Submissions are extended to September 24th! 🎥👯‍♂️🎭

Want to audition for The Gondoliers but don’t have time for an in person audition? Never fear! Send in a self tape for consideration! Any 1-2 minute recording of you singing any song is welcome (even an older video, up to a year old maximum).

NOTE: Submitting a self tape does NOT reduce your chances of getting a leading role! We will consider you all the same and invite you to callbacks if we’re interested in hearing more!

Submit today before we sail away!
